purpose: Resolve La Libertad outlet identity reproducibly from authoritative static ANA faja-marginal channel geometry plus D8, without reading the sealed 2015-03-23 territorial outcome or using morphometry/rainfall as a fitting signal.

source_admissibility.title: Resolución Directoral N° 2059-2015-ANA-AAA-CAÑETE-FORTALEZA
source_admissibility.admissibility_basis: The resolution demarcates the hydraulic public-domain faja marginal of the named Quebrada Libertad. ANA records show the 2015 faja-marginal work program was established in the 2015 institutional operating plan; this method uses only paired static bank coordinates/progressives, not 2015 activation, damage, vulnerability, rainfall, or morphometric agreement.
source_admissibility.caution: The final survey/resolution postdates 23-03-2015; therefore it is admitted only as static channel geometry. Any independent evidence that the surveyed course was relocated by the 2015 event forces PENDING_REVIEW rather than reinterpretation.

static_channel_anchors.midpoint_rule: For each matched progressive, use the arithmetic midpoint of the published right/left bank coordinates. This rule is frozen before DEM execution.

independent_pre2015_identity_support.statement_used: La Libertad is a distinct right-bank Rímac quebrada near/above the Plaza de Armas de Chosica.

predeclared_resolution_method.name: ANA_RD2059_TWO_BANK_MIDPOINT_UPSTREAM_ANCHORED_D8_CHANNEL_SNAP
predeclared_resolution_method.step_1: Map the frozen 0+825 centerline midpoint to the 30 m DEM grid and enumerate only immediate coordinate-to-grid ambiguity cells.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_2: Trace D8 downstream from every admissible upstream source cell without using basin area, channel length, slope, rainfall, response, or outcome information.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_3: For each trace select the traced named-channel cell nearest the frozen 0+000 centerline midpoint.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_4: Require every admissible upstream source-cell trace to converge to exactly the same selected downstream cell and to progress toward 0+000.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_5: Require the selected cell to lie within two 30 m DEM-cell diagonals of the frozen 0+000 centerline midpoint; otherwise remain PENDING_REVIEW.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_6: Only after PASS may the selected cell be frozen as the La Libertad outlet; basin delineation remains a separate frozen pre-unblind step.
